title: SITOP Selectivity modules
inspected: Official PDF text via web tool; input, output and reference terminals inspected.
justification: PSE200U -2BA11 has four positive protected outputs. Its 0 V connection feeds internal electronics; load returns run directly to the supply. Connections 11/12/14 and RST are distinct from load circuits. No internal event history is claimed.

title: PSE200U compact operating instructions
sections: English technical data and LED/reset table, indexed official text
inspected: Technical table supplied by web search of official document, not a downloaded local PDF.
justification: The -2BA11 range is 0.5–3 A per channel. Green indicates output on; red indicates automatic shutdown and flashing red indicates reset availability. Individual pushbuttons and common RST exist. The illustration is a static state and does not establish reset timing or successful Y2 motion.

title: VACF-A-A1-1, part8030822, data sheet
sections: p.1 characteristic coil data, electrical connection and pin diagram; p.2 winding material
inspected: Official two-page PDF text and page1 screenshot. Search index also exposed the numbered pin diagram.
justification: The approved cabinet reference corresponds to 24 VDC and 2.6 W. Form A uses two opposing power contacts, numbered1/2, and a separate PE contact. The sheet does not state a DC winding resistance tolerance. 24²/2.6=221.54 Ω is a calculated nominal equivalent, not a guaranteed ohmmeter reading.

title: S7-1200 CPU1214C wiring diagrams
justification: CPU1214C DC/DC/DC has separate L+/M CPU supply and 3L+/3M DQ supply. Q0.1/Q0.2/Q0.3 remain independent outputs. The pictured order number cannot be read conclusively; this family reference does not certify a particular installed CPU.

title: PSU100S operating instructions
inspected: Official indexed technical table read; opening full PDF returned403.
justification: The listed 6EP1334-2BA20 is a 24 VDC/10 A PSU100S. No new coordination or inrush values are introduced in the case.
